case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Engagement includes clear objective, quantified $2.27M savings across eight categories, multiple signed agreements and detailed proof points—sufficient for a robust case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: Fresh produce distributor captures $2.3M in annual savings by unifying procurement across eight indirect spend categories
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: FreshEdge, a rapidly expanding super-regional fresh food distributor backed by Wind Point Partners, had grown through more than a dozen acquisitions in just four years. Purchasing was highly decentralized across 20+ operating companies, resulting in fragmented vendor relationships, duplicate spend and limited spend visibility. To hit aggressive EBITDA improvement targets, the company needed a systematic, enterprise-wide approach to reduce indirect costs without disrupting operations.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A rapidly expanding super-regional fresh food distributor backed by the private equity ownership group had grown through more than a dozen acquisitions in just four years. Purchasing was highly decentralized across 20+ operating companies, resulting in fragmented vendor relationships, duplicate spend and limited spend visibility. To support operational efficiency and margin improvement goals, the company needed a systematic, enterprise-wide approach to reduce indirect costs without disrupting operations.
approach_summary: Performed a granular spend analysis of $1.14 B in accounts-payable data, cleansing and mapping thousands of vendors and GL codes to identify $41 M in high-potential indirect spend.
Ran competitive RFPs in packaging, corrugate and labeling—aggregating $5.7 M of volume and awarding to Welch Packaging and Bunzl to deliver a 27% cost reduction.
Consolidated eight legacy fuel programs into a single Loves/Pilot fleet card solution, leveraging volume to negotiate best-in-class rebates for the client’s 300-truck fleet.
Brokered fixed-rate electricity and natural-gas contracts for Sirna & Sons locations, locking in four-year energy savings and eliminating commodity price volatility.
Renegotiated incumbent pallet supplier Kamps, securing double-digit savings while maintaining service levels valued by operating companies.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya identified $2.27 million in annual run-rate savings—over 8% of the $27.9 million addressable baseline—while standardizing specifications and supplier terms across eight categories. More than $50 k is already contractually secured, with an additional $2.22 million approved or in implementation, positioning the client to exceed its PE value-creation targets. Beyond dollars, the engagement delivered a cleansed spend cube, common contract templates and a repeatable sourcing playbook the client can use for future categories.
where_we_were_unique: Converted messy, decentralized AP data into an actionable spend cube within six weeks, enabling rapid opportunity sizing.
Balanced enterprise savings with local operating-company preferences, retaining incumbents where service was critical while still extracting double-digit savings.
Leveraged deep packaging market expertise to standardize specs and unlock 27% savings that internal teams had considered unattainable.
Collaborated closely with the private equity sponsor to align sourcing waves with value-creation milestones and board reporting cycles.
